annotations.title: DOM Paywall, Modal Gate & Blurred Content Recovery Auditor

description: Audits web page DOM hierarchies to detect soft paywalls, blur overlays, modal gates, and recovers concealed body text. Use when diagnosing paywall obstructions, diagnosing subscriber gating scripts, or auditing content access barriers; for assessing general SEO hygiene, use evaluate_seo_diagnostics instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'html_content' ('detection_profile' defaults to 'heuristic_dom_overlay'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

detection_profile.description: Paywall detection heuristic: heuristic DOM overlay, hidden text recovery, or strict access barrier audit.

html_content.description: Target web page HTML markup suspected of containing soft paywalls or paywall modals.

target_domain.description: Optional publishing domain name to look up publisher gating patterns.

name: detect_paywall_and_bypass

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for detect_paywall_and_bypass.

confidence_score.description: Confidence metric between 0.0 and 1.0 regarding paywall detection.

paywall_detected.description: True if paywall scripts, blur filters, or gate overlays were identified.

paywall_type.description: Classification of paywall barrier (e.g., soft_modal_overlay, blurred_content, hard_truncation).

recovered_content.description: Recovered readable prose extracted from under DOM overlay or script tags.

title: DOM Paywall, Modal Gate & Blurred Content Recovery Auditor
